title: lycopodium selago var. miniatum
intro: Lycopodium selago var. miniatum, commonly known as Dwarf Club Moss, is a type of evergreen, perennial plant belonging to the club moss family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and congestion. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Club Moss include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, making it useful for treating a range of conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lycopodium selago var. miniatum include lignans, terpenes, and essential oils, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
